title: Choose an action
summary: Julia: Choose an action. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if selects steps using a true-or-false rule. end closes the block.

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.

blocks.title: Choose an action
blocks.code:
score = 8
if score >= 5
 println("Pass")
else
 println("Try again")
end

blocks.text: The condition is true, selecting the first println.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Julia requires a Boolean condition, not a bare number.
